coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH1Bibliosoph-Hint: Every feature below can be switched off independently, so you can take only the parts you want. Players see the handful of settings that are genuinely theirs — toolbar buttons, message splashes, dice animations; everything else is the GM's.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH4Introduction-Hint: Bibliosoph gives the table a memory. When a blow lands hard it becomes a named injury that lingers and has to be treated; a natural 20 or a 1 draws a real critical or fumble with mechanics behind it, not just a line of prose. Great moments at the table earn inspiration cards a player holds in their inventory and spends when it counts. It also rolls encounters against your party's strength, handles searching a room, and carries private messages between players without cluttering the chat log. Everything arrives as a themed card, and anything with teeth applies itself to the token with one click. The content ships as journal compendiums you can copy and rewrite — the injuries, criticals, fumbles and cards are all yours to edit.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.showDiceRolls-Hint: Show Dice So Nice 3D dice for table rolls when cards are generated. Requires the Dice So Nice module; does nothing without it.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH2Messaging-Hint: The unified conversation window: party-wide and private group messages with history, without touching the Foundry chat log.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messagesEnabled-Hint: Enable the unified Messages window (party and private conversations).
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.toolbarMessages-Hint: Which toolbar carries the Messages button. To remove the button entirely, switch Messages off above.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.gmSeesAllConversations-Hint: When enabled, the GM's Messages window lists every conversation, including ones the GM is not a member of. When disabled, the GM only sees conversations they belong to.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.retentionMaxMessages-Hint: Maximum messages kept per conversation. Older messages are trimmed automatically as new ones arrive.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messagesExcludedUsers-Hint: Comma-separated user names to leave out of Messages (no 1:1 row, not selectable for groups, not added to the party conversation). Case-insensitive; matches the exact name or the start of it (e.g. 'developer' matches 'DeveloperXXX'). This is only about Messages — it does not hide toasts. Toast visibility lives in Blacksmith under Toast Excluded Users, and which announcements reach those users anyway is set there too (see Toast Channels below).
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.hideMessagesJournal-Hint: Hides the conversations journal folder from the journal sidebar for everyone.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messageAutoOpen-Hint: Automatically open the Messages window when a message arrives while it is closed.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messageSplashEnabled-Hint: Show an on-screen splash when you receive a direct message you are not currently viewing. Click the splash to open the conversation.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messageSplashGroupEnabled-Hint: Show an on-screen splash when a message arrives in a party or group conversation you are not currently viewing.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messageSoundAlert-Hint: Played when a message arrives while the Messages window is closed or focused on another conversation.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messageSoundReceive-Hint: Played when a new message posts in the conversation you are viewing.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messageSoundSend-Hint: Played when you send a message.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messageSoundSwitch-Hint: Played when you switch to another conversation.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.messageSoundClose-Hint: Played when you close the Messages window.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.cardThemePartyMessage-Hint: Card theme used when a party message is sent to the Foundry chat.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.cardThemePrivateMessage-Hint: Card theme used when a private or group message is sent to the Foundry chat.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH3RandomToasts-Hint: Buttons in the Messages window header that roll a table and toast the result to everyone. Choosing None disables the button. These toasts use the channel name 'social' — add it to Blacksmith's Channels Excluded Users Still See to let a camera or stream account see them.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.toolbarInvestigation-Hint: Which toolbar carries the Investigation button. To remove the button entirely, switch Investigation off above.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationCoinsOdds-Hint: Chance (0–100) to find coins when investigating. Roll 1d100 ≤ this value to find coins.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationCoinsMaxPlatinum-Hint: Maximum platinum pieces that can be found (0–max rolled).
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationCoinsMaxGold-Hint: Maximum gold pieces that can be found (0–max rolled).
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationCoinsMaxSilver-Hint: Maximum silver pieces that can be found (0–max rolled).
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationCoinsMaxElectrum-Hint: Maximum electrum pieces that can be found (0–max rolled).
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationCoinsMaxCopper-Hint: Maximum copper pieces that can be found (0–max rolled).
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationOddsCommon-Hint: Relative weight (0–1000) for Common when rolling rarity. Weights are normalized; use low values (e.g. 1) for very rare tiers.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationOddsUncommon-Hint: Relative weight for Uncommon when rolling rarity.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationOddsRare-Hint: Relative weight for Rare when rolling rarity.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationOddsVeryRare-Hint: Relative weight for Very Rare when rolling rarity.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationOddsLegendary-Hint: Relative weight for Legendary when rolling rarity.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationInventorySummaryNoActor: No character or token selected; items were not added to inventory.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.investigationCoinsSummaryNoActor: No character or token selected; coins were not added.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH2Critical-Hint: Critical hits are the stuff of legend. Draw from a critical roll table when the moment strikes, and announce every natural 20 to the whole table with an on-screen toast the instant the dice land.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH3CriticalToastDesign-Hint: Codes for the title and message: {name} who rolled, {target} who they hit, {weapon} what they attacked with, {d20} the die face, {total} the attack total. This toast uses the channel name 'crit' — add it to Blacksmith's Channels Excluded Users Still See to let a camera or stream account see criticals despite being toast-excluded.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH2Fumbles-Hint: Sometimes the dice betray you. Draw from a fumble table to give failure real consequences, and let the whole table savor the disaster with an on-screen toast whenever a natural 1 hits.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH3FumbleToastDesign-Hint: Codes for the title and message: {name} who rolled, {target} who they attacked, {weapon} what they attacked with, {d20} the die face, {total} the attack total. This toast uses the channel name 'fumble' — add it to Blacksmith's Channels Excluded Users Still See to let a camera or stream account see fumbles despite being toast-excluded.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.toolbarInspiration-Hint: Which toolbar carries the Inspiration button. To remove the button entirely, switch Inspiration off above.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH2Inspiration-Hint: Reward great moments at the table. Draw from an inspiration table to hand out flavorful boons with a themed card — destined to grow into a full deck experience supporting many kinds of cards.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH2Injuries-Hint: Injuries are what happens when a hit lands so hard it may leave permanent damage. Trigger them by hand from the toolbar, or automatically when a single hit deals a chosen percentage of max HP — the injury is rolled by the damage type that caused it.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH3InjuriesConfiguration-Hint: Automation triggers when a single application of damage deals at least the threshold percent of the target's max HP. The injury is rolled from the compendium by the hit's dominant damage type.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryAutoApply-Hint: Automation-created injury cards skip the Apply button — the injury lands on the damaged character immediately and the card shows who it was applied to.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH3InjuriesTreatment-Hint: Injuries linger until someone treats them. The Check-Up toolbar button posts a patient's afflictions with a Treat button on each; the GM always treats instantly, while players roll Medicine against the injury's difficulty.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryTreatmentRolls-Hint: Anyone can attempt to treat an injury with a Medicine check against its DC (one attempt per character per injury). A Healer's Kit grants Advantage and lowers the DC by 2; treating yourself imposes Disadvantage. The GM always treats instantly without rolling. Off: only the GM and the character's owner can treat, instantly.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryTreatmentCritFumble-Hint: A natural 20 heals the injury regardless of DC and restores 5 HP. A natural 1 fails and deals 5 HP damage to the patient.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryTreatmentKitUses-Hint: Whether a treatment attempt spends a use of the Healer's Kit. Kits without limited uses are never consumed.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryTreatmentKitNames-Hint: Comma-separated item names that count as a healer's kit for treatment rolls. Add your own kits, or localised names, so they grant the same Advantage and lowered DC.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryTreatmentAttemptReset-Hint: A character gets one attempt per injury. This is when that resets, so a failed attempt is a setback rather than a permanent dead end.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryTreatmentDcEscalation-Hint: How much harder an injury gets after each failed treatment attempt, in DC. 0 disables it, so repeated attempts are free retries.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryTreatmentSound-Hint: Plays when an affliction is successfully treated and lifts from the token.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryApplySound-Hint: Plays when an injury lands on a token, alongside the burst animation.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.injuryCompendium-Hint: The journal compendium injuries are drawn from. Defaults to the Injuries compendium bundled with Bibliosoph; choose another to use your own.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.critCompendium-Hint: A compendium of typed critical pages — these carry real mechanics (damage, conditions, durations, and roll modifiers) that the Apply button puts straight onto the token. Journals inside it are severity buckets for browsing only; each page states its own. This is the only source of criticals; set it to None and no critical cards are posted.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.fumbleCompendium-Hint: As above, for fumbles. Set it to None and no fumble cards are posted.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.inspirationCompendium-Hint: A compendium of typed inspiration cards. Drawing a card grants the character an inspiration point; using the card spends it. Cards that are a plain state change (heal to full, long rest, raise the dead) resolve with a button; the rest are narrative. This is the only source of cards; set it to None and nothing can be drawn.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.outcomeImageEnabled-Hint: Show the artwork on critical and fumble cards. This one switch covers both, so turning it off here also turns it off for criticals.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH3InjuriesToastDesign-Hint: Codes for the title and message: {name} who was injured, {type} the damage type, {damage} the damage taken, {percent} the percent of max HP. This toast uses the channel name 'injury' — add it to Blacksmith's Channels Excluded Users Still See to let a camera or stream account see injuries despite being toast-excluded.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.headingH2Encounters-Hint: Set the odds of encountering a monster, configure your thresholds, and the Quick Encounter tool does the rest.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.quickEncounterEnabled-Hint: Show the Quick Encounter tool (CR-aware encounter builder) in the toolbar.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.quickEncounterCacheStatusTitle-Hint: Recommend and Roll use cached data for speed.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.quickEncounterCacheNone-Label: No cache — click Refresh to build
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.quickEncounterCacheNoneTitle-Hint: Build a cache to make Recommend and Roll much faster.
coffee-pub-bibliosoph.toolbarQuickEncounter-Hint: Which toolbar carries the Quick Encounter button. To remove the button entirely, switch Quick Encounter off above.
